source: Tiingo original adjusted Open and Close, no synthetic leveraged bars

methods.signals: Closing signals from t-1 or earlier
methods.execution: At adjusted Open(t), earn overnight gap on existing holdings, then Open-to-Close return after rebalance
methods.positions: Holdings drift naturally; cash is unallocated part; no margin/shorting
methods.warmup: All start with cash and first trade after 252 common trading sessions
methods.fee: All-in round-trip modeled as per-direction 15/30/60 bps of traded notional; no separate market impact
methods.cash_rates: 0% and 3% annualized fixed assumptions, not observed historical risk-free rates
methods.benchmarks: QQQ buy-hold, 4x 1x ETF buy-hold, monthly rebalanced 1x ETF basket
methods.rsi_macd_ablation: V5 volatility controls intact, only oscillator-confirmed recovery condition removed
methods.no_lookahead: Signals use only closes to t-1; no intraday signal use

limitations: Not true out of sample: rule selection made using historical performance
Adjusted Open/Close is dividend reinvestment proxy, not exact cash-flow execution
No per-ticker bid/ask spread, liquidity, market-impact, fill probability or taxes
Cash yield assumed flat, not contemporaneous money market actuals
ETF survivorship/selection and provider historical data revisions possible
V5 family includes no volume signal
Historical subperiods are descriptive, not independent walk-forward tests
